Metrics.Name: graph2otel.event.lag
Metrics.Description: Age of a source event when graph2otel handed its log record to the telemetry emitter.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.event.over_horizon
Metrics.Description: Log records dropped because their event time was older than the backend's accept window, so sending them would have been rejected per-entry and lost anyway.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.ingest.cost.projected
Metrics.Description: Estimated recurring steady-state ingest cost projected from cumulative process-lifetime observations; payload-byte attribution is estimated, not an invoice.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.ingest.emitted_points
Metrics.Description: Exact metric and log points emitted after cardinality limiting and handed to the OpenTelemetry SDK.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.degraded
Metrics.Description: Whether the most recent exporter callback failure remains unrecovered by a successful export.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.export_attempts
Metrics.Description: Exporter callback attempts since process start.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.export_failures
Metrics.Description: Exporter callbacks that returned an error since process start.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.export_successes
Metrics.Description: Exporter callbacks accepted since process start.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.force_flush_failures
Metrics.Description: Exporter force-flush callbacks that returned an error since process start.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.delivery.shutdown_failures
Metrics.Description: Exporter shutdown callbacks that returned an error since process start.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.retry_attempts
Metrics.Description: Exact second-and-later exporter retry-loop attempts; excludes redirects and transparent connection retries.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.otlp.transmitted_payload.bytes
Metrics.Description: Exact post-compression OTLP payload bytes accepted by the client transport; excludes protocol and network framing.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.series.active
Metrics.Description: Exact distinct active time series emitted for `metric.name` during the last export interval, AFTER cardinality limiting — the series actually billed. What was shed is graph2otel.series.clipped.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.series.clipped
Metrics.Description: Series clipped from `metric.name` during the last interval: `mode=folded` were summed into the `other` bucket, `mode=dropped` were discarded because the metric is not additive and a synthetic aggregate would be worse than the loss.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.series.limit
Metrics.Description: Configured per-metric active-series limit (cardinality.per_metric_limit): past it the top series by value are kept and the tail is folded into an `other` bucket or dropped. Emitted only when a positive limit is configured.

Metrics.Name: graph2otel.series.total
Metrics.Description: Total distinct active time series across every metric during the last export interval, against cardinality.global_limit.
